description: Machine-readable validation catalogue for the Monthly Market Watch workbook. Severity, tolerances and thresholds are configurable here; handlers live in src/validation/rules.ts and are matched by id.

rules.name: Required sheets present
rules.description: Every sheet marked required in the import map exists in the workbook.

rules.name: Extraction anchors found
rules.description: Each label/chart/pivot anchor needed by the import map was found (otherwise the template has changed).

rules.name: TOC sections resolve to a sheet
rules.description: Every Table-of-Content entry maps to a sheet. 'Planned vs Achieved' has no sheet — it is located in FG Details charts.

rules.name: Visible sheet without cell data
rules.description: A visible sheet that holds no cell data (only charts/pictures) cannot be a data source.

rules.name: Broken defined names (#REF!)
rules.description: Workbook contains defined names that resolve to #REF!.

rules.name: External workbook links
rules.description: Formulas depend on external workbooks that are only partially cached and cannot refresh without the source file.

rules.name: Manually overwritten formula cells
rules.description: Cells inside a formula-driven column were typed over (hard-coded).

rules.name: Formula error cells
rules.description: No cell holds #REF!, #DIV/0!, #N/A, #VALUE!.

rules.name: Constants typed inside formulas
rules.description: Values are typed as '=18081/100' rather than stored as data.

rules.name: Average CFR methodology
rules.description: Workbook CFR average is a simple mean over buyer lines (not per vessel, not quantity-weighted). The Data Center reports a quantity-weighted average.

rules.name: YoY not computable (zero base)
rules.description: A component has a zero prior-period base, so YoY % is undefined and is shown as Missing, not 0 or ∞.

rules.name: Reporting month detected
rules.description: Table of Content carries a valid Edition/Month stamp.

rules.name: YTD headers match reporting year
rules.description: Current YTD year equals reporting year and prior YTD year equals reporting year − 1.

rules.name: Price window ends at reporting month
rules.description: The last month of every price series equals the reporting month and months are contiguous.

rules.name: Future months not loaded as zero
rules.description: Months after the reporting month hold 0 in the workbook; they are stored as Missing (future), never as 0.

rules.name: Mixed reporting periods in E-BG total
rules.description: 'Total Transaction Volume – YTD' adds BG (pivot coverage) to DCF (pivot coverage); coverage must be identical.

rules.name: BG pivot coverage vs underlying records
rules.description: The BG pivot on the E-BG sheet must cover the same months and regions as the cached BG records.

rules.name: Records dated after reporting month
rules.description: No BG/DCF record may start after the last day of the reporting month.

rules.name: Stale or undated news / updates
rules.description: News and department updates older than the staleness limit (or undated) are flagged.

rules.name: Vessel dates valid
rules.description: Departure/arrival are real dates and arrival is not before departure; missing arrival on a departed vessel is flagged.

rules.name: Datasets populated
rules.description: Every core dataset contains records.

rules.name: Core volumes present
rules.description: Industry and FG YTD current/prior values are all numeric.

rules.name: Price cells present
rules.description: No missing cell in the price grids.

rules.name: Vessel fields complete
rules.description: CFR price numeric, vessel named, quantity present.

rules.name: Geography complete
rules.description: Every district row has a zone, region and district; every period has all five numeric values.

rules.name: Blank placeholder records
rules.description: Pivot-cache rows with no region/bank/customer carry no information and are excluded from analytics (counted, not hidden).

rules.name: No negative volumes or prices
rules.description: Volumes, quantities, amounts and prices are ≥ 0.

rules.name: Month-on-month price jump
rules.description: Flags price moves larger than the threshold.

rules.name: Commodity YoY outlier
rules.description: Absolute YoY above threshold needs source confirmation.

rules.name: Shares are fractions 0–1
rules.description: Percent vs decimal check: every share must be within [0,1].

rules.name: DAP unit & price plausibility
rules.description: Vessel quantities are in '000 MT (≤ 100) and CFR is within a plausible band.

rules.name: Achievement extremes
rules.description: Monthly achievement outside the band is flagged.

rules.name: YTD YoY outlier
rules.description: Absolute YTD YoY above threshold.

rules.name: FG ≤ Industry
rules.description: FG YTD off-take cannot exceed industry YTD sales for any product.

rules.name: FG volumes: FG Details vs District-wise national
rules.description: National FG volumes in Dis. Wise Share reconcile to FG Details.

rules.name: Geography hierarchy reconciles
rules.description: Districts → region totals → zone totals → national for every component and period.

rules.name: Reported FG share recomputes
rules.description: (FG primary + FG secondary) / (FFC + Engro + FG primary + FG secondary) equals the printed share.

rules.name: Share-change columns labelled correctly
rules.description: 'Change in FG share 23-24 / 24-25' columns must measure the periods their label claims; duplicated columns are flagged.

rules.name: Company shares sum to 100%
rules.description: Each group/period sums to 100% within tolerance.

rules.name: Share chart vs underlying volumes
rules.description: FG share in the YTD-2026 chart equals FG volume ÷ industry volume.

rules.name: Two different 'FG nitrogen/phosphate share' bases
rules.description: Dis. Wise Share measures FG share within a tracked competitor set (FFC+Engro+FG), whereas Market Share charts use the whole industry. Both are valid; they must not be compared.

rules.name: Plan totals reconcile
rules.description: Total column = Σ months; All-products = Σ product series for every month.

rules.name: Achieved vs FG off-take
rules.description: YTD 'Achieved' (plan sheet) vs FG YTD off-take by product.

rules.name: Production share vs product production
rules.description: Pie of producers (FG/FFC/Engro/AgriTech) vs total production in the product chart.

rules.name: Order-book subtotals
rules.description: Subtotal rows equal the sum of their component rows.

rules.name: DAP summary reconciles
rules.description: Reported total quantity, vessel count and company quantities equal values recomputed from vessel lines.

rules.name: Price variance = Trade − DTP
rules.description: Variance table equals Trade price minus DTP for every series and month.

rules.name: Commodity YoY recomputes
rules.description: (current ÷ prior) − 1 equals the reported YoY.

rules.name: DCF records vs DCF pivot
rules.description: Monthly order value in cached records equals the DCF pivot table.

rules.name: E-BG sheet totals
rules.description: Total = BG + E-BG + DCF on the E-BG sheet, and BG/E-BG equal the BG pivot grand total.

rules.name: Duplicate vessel lines
rules.description: Same vessel + buyer + quantity appears more than once.

rules.name: Duplicate BG rows
rules.description: Identical BG No + Order No pairs.

rules.name: Duplicate DCF rows
rules.description: Identical DCF system number + dealer + order value among populated rows.

rules.name: Duplicate news items
rules.description: Same headline (first 60 chars) appears more than once.

rules.name: Name standardisation applied
rules.description: Raw buyer/company names were mapped to canonical names (Fauji→FFC, Fatima→FG …); unmapped buyers grouped as Other / Private.

rules.name: Mis-encoded text repaired
rules.description: Mojibake (â€™ etc.) in news text was repaired.
